PC04-X01.name: New Generation Ultraman Blazar
PC04-X01.effect:
When your "New Generation" Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 12000 BP. For each Spirit destroyed by this effect, send a core, other than [Soul Core], from your Trash to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. When you've done so, during this battle, this Spirit gains +10000 BP. This "target attack" can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Heavy Armor].

PC04-002.name: New Generation Ultraman Decker Flash Type
PC04-002.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
All your “New Generation” gain +5000 BP. Also, when your “Ultraman” would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by discarding this Mirage, all those Spirits remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By discarding an "Ultraman" from your Hand, destroy an opposing one-symbol Spirit.

PC04-001.name: New Generation Ultraman Trigger Multi Type
PC04-001.effect:
(Can't Stack) When returning this card from the Trash to the deck, during this turn, all your "New Generation Ultraman Reiga" gain an extra Red symbol, and reduce +1 opposing Life via effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can reveal three card from your decktop. Among them, besides any "New Generation Ultraman Trigger Multi Type", add an "Ultraman" card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

PC04-003.name: New Generation Ultraman Zett Alpha Edge
PC04-003.effect:
When summoning this card from the Hand, for each "New Generation" in your Trash, this card's cost gets -1 (Max. -3).

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy either an opposing 20000 BP or less Spirit, or an opposing Nexus, and when destroys, draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by discarding three cards from your decktop, this Spirit refreshes.

PC04-006.name: Trigger Truth ［2］
PC04-006.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as “Ultraman”, and its reduction symbols are also treated as Red.

This set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy two opposing Cost 9 or less Spirits. If you control any Nexus, effects of the Spirits destroyed by this effect can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, if you have any card set, this Spirit can refresh.

PC04-004.name: Ultraman Blazar
PC04-004.effect:
This card/[Mirage]'s reduction symbols are also treated as Red/White.

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Blue Core])]
[During Set] (Opposing Turn)
When the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect, +1 core to one of your "Ultraman" Grandwalker Nexuses.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put one core from the Void each to two "Ultraman" Spirits you control.

PC04-005.name: Ultraman Decker Dynamic Type
PC04-005.effect:
This card/[Change]'s reduction symbols are also treated as Red.

Flash - [Change: Cost 5 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core])]
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit. After this effect resolves, discard this card, or replace one of your Cost 7 or less "Ultraman"-named Spirits with this card in refreshed condition, or pay one cost to summon it.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.
